messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-01-23] standup/ember/2026-01-23: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2026-06-17] standup/ember/2026-06-17: Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego Alvarez today.
- [2025-05-28] standup/ember/2025-05-28: Observation from Ember: after the cache change, Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week. Reminder: Oskar Lind is on call for team Ember this cycle.
- [2026-05-13] standup/ember/2026-05-13: Diego has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.
- [2025-01-13] standup/ember/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Ember team goes to Oskar.
- [2025-11-05] standup/ember/2025-11-05: Heads-up from Ember: notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.
- [2026-03-16] standup/ember/2026-03-16: Oskar has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Diego Alvarez. Ember noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-10] standup/ember/2025-01-10: Oskar is the only engineer on team Ember for now.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2026-04-29] standup/ember/2026-04-29: Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-23] standup/ember/2025-04-23: The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02: Yuki picked up the Cinder on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2025-05-21] standup/boreal/2025-05-21: Lena picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Marcus today.
- [2025-11-10] standup/ember/2025-11-10: Heads-up from team Ember: the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2026-05-28] standup/cinder/2026-05-28: Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2026-01-02] standup/boreal/2026-01-02: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-17] standup/ember/2025-11-17: Team Ember saw that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it. The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11-2: Observation from team Ember: after the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20-2: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember.
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01: From today the ledger service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-01-14] standup/dune/2026-01-14: Reminder: Tomasz is on call for team Dune this cycle.
- [2025-07-22] standup/cinder/2025-07-22: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki Tanaka carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-05-05] standup/boreal/2026-05-05: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.
- [2025-08-29] standup/cinder/2025-08-29: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-03-05] standup/dune/2025-03-05: Reporting deploy window: on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2026-05-01] standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2: Observation from the Cinder team: after the marketing send, the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2026-05-04] standup/boreal/2026-05-04: Team Boreal has switched to a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-04-14] standup/atlas/2026-04-14: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
